# A free Kleinian group generated by two parabolic transformations

↑ **Parent:** [Kleinian group](kleinian-group.md)

The integer matrices $A=(\begin{smallmatrix}1&2\\0&1\end{smallmatrix})$ and $B=(\begin{smallmatrix}1&0\\2&1\end{smallmatrix})$ generate a discrete subgroup. For every nonzero integer $m$, $A^m$ sends $|x|<1$ into $|x|>1$, while $B^m$ sends $|x|>1$, including infinity, into $|x|<1$. The [ping-pong lemma](ping-pong-lemma.md) identifies their subgroup as the [free product](free-product.md) of two infinite cyclic groups. This separates the proof of discreteness from the proof of freeness.
